Publish attempt correctly fails *closed* with a Rust-owned diagnostic ("pre-signed publish target rejected: requires an explicit non-empty imported/protocol relay target") rather than crashing — proves the dispatch/signing/relay path is wired end-to-end even though this fresh throwaway key had no relay list to resolve against. Didn't chase this further since it's orthogonal to the re-pin (pre-existing app relay-target-resolution behavior, not a regression from the version bump) — flagging in case you want it looked at separately.
